sources.title: Azerbaijan MFA: Visa-free countries
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.officialityEvidence: The current MFA consular schedule directly lists the ordinary-passport reciprocal and temporary unilateral visa-free regimes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The schedule lists regular passports in Group II and temporary ordinary-passport visa-free admission in Group IV.

sources.title: ASAN Visa: Countries eligible for e-visa
sources.publisher: State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations under the President of Azerbaijan
sources.officialityEvidence: The official ASAN Visa service publishes the current nationality eligibility schedule and temporary-waiver markings.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Countries eligible for e-visa are listed; marked nationalities have temporary visa-free admission under stated rules.

sources.title: ASAN Visa: Conditions for issuing electronic visas
sources.publisher: State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations under the President of Azerbaijan
sources.officialityEvidence: This live official ASAN Visa page describes electronic issuance, timing, validity and document requirements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A standard e-visa is issued within three working days, is single-entry, and permits thirty days stay within ninety days.

sources.title: Azerbaijan Permanent Mission: Single Entry Visa
sources.publisher: Permanent Mission of the Republic of Azerbaijan to the United Nations
sources.officialityEvidence: A current official MFA mission page states the entry-visa default, separates eVisa eligibility, and gives consular single-entry visa documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Travel requires an entry visa unless a visa-free agreement exists; eligible countries can apply through ASAN Visa.

sources.title: Azerbaijan MFA: General information about visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.officialityEvidence: The current MFA page defines ordinary entry visas and expressly includes tourism as an ordinary-visa purpose.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary entry visas can be issued for tourism, personal travel, business, education, labor, culture, sport and treatment.

policies.title: Current reciprocal ordinary-passport visa-free admission
policies.summary: The current MFA Group II schedule directly names these passports for visa-free visitor entry, including regular/ordinary passports where specified.
conditions: This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline. Group II lists 90-day stays for all named codes except Qatar (30 days), China (30 days per entry and 90 days per 180), and Russia (90 days in a calendar year).

The Group II regime is not a work, study, long-stay, special-document, citizenship, final-admission, or entry-after-an-applicable restriction determination. The MFA expressly requires Qatar work or study visitors, and Maldives visitors exceeding 90 days or working/studying/doing business, to obtain a visa in advance.

policies.title: Hong Kong and Macao ordinary passports: temporary visa-free visitor waiver
policies.summary: The current MFA Group IV schedule directly grants holders of ordinary passports issued by Hong Kong and Macao SAR governments a temporary visitor waiver.
conditions: The waiver is limited to three entries during the stated period and up to 30 days on each entry. A valid visa is required for a fourth entry or after expiry.

This applies only to ordinary passports issued by the Hong Kong or Macao SAR governments; it is not transferred to mainland Chinese passports, other PRC documents, residence, work, study, special documents, citizenship, or final admission.

policies.title: Other recognized ordinary passports: consular advance visitor visa
policies.summary: These codes have no current MFA ordinary-passport visa-free rule or ASAN eVisa listing. The MFA's current default requires an entry visa and directs non-eVisa applicants to a consular single-entry application.
conditions: This policy is for a recognized ordinary passport used for tourism or personal travel. The current MFA describes tourism and personal travel as ordinary entry-visa purposes and requires pre-travel consular documents; it is not an eVisa conclusion from the MFA application portal.

ASAN eVisa eligibility is nationality-list limited. Airport visa issuance, third-country residence permits, direct-flight privileges, emergencies, Formula 1/event documents, transit, diplomatic, service, special, refugee, stateless and other travel-document routes are conditional and excluded.
Individual entry restrictions, passport validity, invitation/document requirements, carrier checks and final border admission remain applicable.

application.label: Azerbaijan consular single-entry visa application
steps: Apply to the relevant Azerbaijan diplomatic mission or consular section before travel with the completed application and valid ordinary passport.
For tourism, provide the stated hotel booking and inbound/outbound airline-ticket evidence.
Obtain the issued entry visa before travelling and meet final border-admission requirements.

unresolved.reason: No current MFA/ASAN source reviewed establishes that this modeled passport or travel document is recognized for the general consular visitor-visa default. Its omission from visa-free and eVisa schedules is not proof of a prohibition or of consular eligibility.
